articles.title: Chicago Cubs will play regular-season finale in Tampa because of storm headed for Boston
articles.description: Because of the incoming nor’easter hitting the Boston area, the Chicago Cubs regular-season finale Sunday against the Red Sox is being moved to Tropicana Field in Tampa, Fla.

articles.title: Column: With Chicago Cubs locked in, will we see an epic Pete Crow-Armstrong-Shohei Ohtani encore in October?
articles.description: It became apparent in August that he and Shohei Ohtani were the only viable candidates for the National League MVP award. They staged an epic duel Aug. 5 at Wrigley Field, both homering in their first ...

articles.title: Veteran Chicago Cubs outfielder Ian Happ tosses cash and a baseball to bleachers fan: ‘Beers on me’
articles.description: On what could be Ian Happ’s last regular-season home game at Wrigley Field, the career-long Cubs outfielder threw a viral curveball.

articles.title: ‘OK, job isn’t done’: Chicago Cubs toast return to postseason — and eye a deeper run
articles.description: The Chicago Cubs sealed a second straight playoff berth Thursday, clinching a National League wild-card spot. “I feel like I’m living on a dream,” Ryan Rolison said.

articles.title: Chicago Cubs to play a doubleheader Friday in Boston with a nor’easter forecast for final series
articles.description: Due to an expected nor’easter, the Chicago Cubs are now scheduled to play a doubleheader Friday against the Boston Red Sox at Fenway Park.

articles.title: Chicago Cubs try to plot the rotation after 12-inning loss — and lefty Justin Steele could return this weekend
articles.description: The Chicago Cubs had a fantastic opportunity to clinch a playoff spot Tuesday night against the Miami Marlins, but lost in 12 innings.

articles.title: Photos: Chicago Cubs beat Miami Marlins 2-1 to clinch playoff berth at Wrigley Field
articles.description: Photos from the Chicago Cubs’ 2-1 victory against the Miami Marlins on Sept. 24, 2026, at Wrigley Field. The Cubs clinched a playoff berth with the win.

articles.title: Column: In a splendid moment of Chicago baseball symmetry, White Sox and Cubs clinch 2 minutes apart
articles.description: The idea of both Chicago teams getting a bite of the postseason seemed laughable before the Wrigley Field ivy turned green.

articles.title: Chicago Cubs 3B Alex Bregman won’t go on the injured list despite multiple facial fractures
articles.description: Chicago Cubs third baseman Alex Bregman is not ruled out for the regular season, but he still has significant swelling in his face and around his left eye that must improve.

articles.title: Photos: Miami Marlins 8, Chicago Cubs 2 (12)
articles.description: Photos from the Chicago Cubs’ 8-2 loss to the Miami Marlins in 12 innings at Wrigley Field on Tuesday, Sept. 22, 2026.

articles.title: After his franchise mark falls, Billy Williams salutes PCA’s evolution during historic Chicago Cubs season
articles.description: It took 56 years, but Pete Crow-Armstrong broke Billy Williams’ Cubs record for home runs by a left-handed hitter. “Ain’t no telling what this kid is going to do in Chicago,” Williams said.

articles.title: Michael Busch’s baserunning miscue and Chicago Cubs’ lack of execution prove costly in 6-4 loss in Cincinnati
articles.description: For a Chicago Cubs team trying to secure the NL’s top wild-card spot, there were ample moments Friday night that they might dwell on as missed opportunities.
